Class WikipediaUDFValueResolver

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.resolver.WikipediaUDFValueResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
IUDFValueResolver
@Component public class WikipediaUDFValueResolver extends Object implements IUDFValueResolver
Resolves the Wikipedia article of the Wikidata item that carries the ISIN of the security as statement P946 — for a share usually the article of the issuer, for a fund the fund or its family when such an item exists. The argument is a list of Wikipedia language codes in order of preference; the first language with an article wins. Two requests per security go out to the Action API of Wikidata: a search for the statement and the entities found. The search index is eventually consistent and can return near matches, so only entities whose P946 claims contain the ISIN exactly are kept. Only the ISIN leaves the instance. Requests are separated by at least 250 ms; since the background worker runs one task at a time, they are serial for the whole instance.
